chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Safwan from al-'Iyyas ibn al-Qasim said:

I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about Fitrah (Zakat al-Fitr), when is it? He said: 'Before the prayer on the day of Fitrah.' I said: 'And if some of it remains after the prayer?' He said: 'There is no harm; we give to our dependents from it, then what remains is distributed.'

key_terms.اَلْفِطْرَة: Zakat al-Fitr, the alms-tax given at the end of Ramadan

ai.seo_question: When should Zakat al-Fitr be paid and what happens if it is paid after the Eid prayer?
ai.summary: This narration from Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib* highlights the juristic preference for distributing Zakat al-Fitr before the Eid prayer to ensure the poor can partake in the festivities. It further clarifies that if any portion remains, it retains its status as valid charity and may be distributed to one’s own family, reflecting the flexibility in Shia fiqh regarding the recipients of Fitrah.
